As a  Intelligence Analyst
, you’ll support Agile teams to help gather requirements, ensure delivery meets required needs, and ensure work will be accepted without any major issues. Mission Data will serve as the resident all-source mission SME on a DoD Intelligence Community data-modernization effort, representing how analysts produce, publish, discover, and use classified mission data. They will work hands-on with the datasets moving across the program — intelligence reporting, imagery-derived products, track and observation data, and technical collections — to validate that discovery, search, and access capabilities work the way real analysts do. They will partner with stakeholders across combatant commands, service intelligence centers, and combat support agencies to translate analyst needs into program requirements.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed
with
our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.
If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!
What you’ll do:

Serve as the resident all-source mission SME on a data-modernization program, representing producer and consumer workflows in requirements, design, demonstration, and test.
Be accountable for day-to-day analytic validation of program capabilities; works directly with representative mission datasets — intelligence reporting, imagery-derived products, track/observation data, technical collections, and mission-support data —defining how each is discovered, evaluated, trusted, and used by analysts.
Be fluent in the program’s data holdings and knowledgeable about all major initiatives, issues, and strategic goals.
Validate AI-enabled discovery and semantic search against real analytic workflows; authors analyst-realistic evaluation scenarios and documents where results would mislead or omit.
Advise on content/discovery metadata and tagging vocabularies (IC-ISM and related IC metadata standards), specifying what an analyst needs to find a dataset and to trust it.
Serve as a liaison between program leadership and mission stakeholders by relaying analyst feedback, escalating concerns, and collaborating on resolutions.
Meet regularly with combatant command J2, service intelligence center, and combat support agency counterparts to ensure a consistent and productive engagement, and initiates feedback sessions.
Fuse multi-discipline intelligence into coherent mission narratives for demonstrations and stakeholder engagements.
Identifiy data and intelligence gaps and recommends which datasets, producers, and partners to onboard next.
Produce metrics views and executive briefings on data consumption and mission impact to ICD 203 standards.
Translate analyst feedback into actionable backlog items and partner with technical leads and solution architects on resolutions.

What you’ll need to succeed:

8+ years of all-source intelligence analysis experience at a national-level intelligence agency, combatant command J2, or service intelligence center.
Demonstrated experience as both a producer and a consumer of classified mission data in an analyst role — has published reporting or datasets for enterprise dissemination, and has discovered and exploited holdings produced by other organizations in their own analysis.
Sustained hands-on experience querying, filtering, structuring, and evaluating classified mission datasets in JWICS/DODIIS-type environments, not solely consuming finished products.

Client service orientation.

You track, analyze, and report on threat actors, campaigns, and emerging attack techniques relevant to the organization and its industry. new_jobs.description:
As a Business Analyst III
, you’ll support our Department of the Air Force (DAF) customer at Joint Base Andrews (with visits to the Pentagon up to 10%). This full-time, onsite role will play a key role in improving DAF business operations by developing enterprise-level performance measures, analyzing performance data, and connecting business function performance to readiness outcomes. This role will provide senior leaders with executive-level reporting, actionable recommendations, and guidance on performance improvement priorities.
We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed
with
our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.
If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!
What you’ll do:

Support the oversight and improvement of DAF business operations by connecting performance metrics, business functions, resource investments, policies, and risk management to readiness outcomes.
Develop, refine, and maintain enterprise-level performance metrics and measurement frameworks for DAF business operations, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, readiness outcomes, and performance standards.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and performance drivers, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for decision-makers.
Produce executive-level reports, dashboards, briefing materials, decision papers, and performance summaries that clearly communicate performance results, risks, gaps, and recommended actions.
Advise customers and senior leaders on performance management, organizational improvement, and continuous-improvement practices used by leading public- and private-sector organizations.
Evaluate and prioritize performance improvement initiatives based on their anticipated readiness impact, strategic alignment, feasibility, resource requirements, and ability to close identified performance gaps.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Active Secret Clearance
5+ years of professional experience in performance management, organizational performance improvement, strategic management, management consulting, business operations, or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, public administration, organizational management, economics, operations research, data analytics, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, or evaluating performance management frameworks, performance measures, or performance baselines.
Experience supporting the DoW, DAF, or other military department, or a comparable federal organization.

We are seeking Data Analyst to support strategic and operational decision-making through data analysis, automation, reporting, and visualization. This role combines hands-on operational responsibilities with the development and implementation of data-driven and AI-enabled solutions.
The ideal candidate has relevant business or operational domain experience, strong analytical and SQL skills, and experience with data modeling, automation, and software testing.

Execute recurring operational activities within an assigned business domain and identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
Design, maintain, and validate data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and analytical workflows using SQL, Python, Spark, Java, and related technologies.
Analyze operational data to identify trends, anomalies, risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Develop and automate reporting, data validation, and operational processes.
Support the design, implementation, and testing of agentic AI solutions, including orchestration, domain analysis, and other specialized workflows.
Test applications, data workflows, and AI-enabled solutions for data accuracy, functionality, usability, and alignment with business requirements.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, visualizations, reports, and business presentations.
Collaborate with business, data, engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver solutions aligned with organizational priorities.

Strong proficiency in SQL and Python.
Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL design, data quality, and performance optimization for analytical workloads.
Experience supporting business operations, reporting, forecasting, pricing, planning, or other enterprise analytical functions.
Experience designing, testing, or implementing automated and AI-enabled workflows, including agentic solutions, preferred.
Familiarity with Java, Apache Airflow, Kafka, Flink, AWS EKS, AWS EMR, or related data and cloud technologies is a plus.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational and domain knowledge into practical analytical and agentic solutions.

to help transform field data into meaningful insights that improve decision-making.

Experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas (e.g., XLOOKUP, TEXTJOIN, COUNTIFS), PivotTables, and VBA.
Experience with SQL and database querying.

Experience with Python, R, Power BI, or other data analysis and visualization tools
Familiarity with SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments

HELP SHAPE THE FUTURE OF CANCER CARE IN CANADA

The Canadian Cancer Society works tirelessly to save lives, improve lives and drive collective action against cancer. Together with patients, volunteers, donors and communities across the country, we raise funds to invest in transformative cancer research, we provide a caring support system for everyone affected by cancer and we advocate to governments to create a healthier future for all. It takes a society to take on cancer – and the Canadian Cancer Society is leading the way

Join an exceptional team of Digital Strategy & Technology professionals helping to power the Canadian Cancer Society’s (CCS) operations and fuel our mission through innovative digital solutions. The Digital Strategy & Technology team is at the forefront of CCS’s digital transformation. Together, they are harnessing digital tools, data and technology to boost fundraising capabilities and enhance the experience of everyone who interacts with us online. With a passion for continuous improvement and a commitment to making an impact, the team ensures CCS’s digital presence is strategic and engaging, helping us inspire and empower more Canadians who care about cancer every day.

MAKING AN IMPACT

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Data Governance and Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytics solutions, reports, and dashboards that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leverage SQL, scripting, and modern analytics platforms to extract, transform, and analyze complex datasets, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that align with business goals
Partner with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-governed analytics solutions
Support a culture of data-driven decision-making by applying automation, engineering best practices, and modern design patterns to improve how data is analyzed, visualized, and utilized across the organization

What You’ll Be Doing

Analytics & Reporting Development

Report & Dashboard Development

Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using Salesforce CRM Analytics, Salesforce Reporting, and Power BI to support organization teams
Build and optimize semantic models and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs
Optimize reporting and dashboard assets for usability, performance and accessibility

Analytics & Insights

Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities across business functions
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business teams
Use predictive models and statistical analyses to support donor segmentation, campaign targeting, and fundraising forecasting
Leverage advanced analytics techniques including propensity scoring, trend analysis, and cohort modeling to inform business strategy

Collaboration & Engagement

Partner with cross-functional teams including business partners, data engineers, and digital teams
Provide guidance and support to business users on reporting and analytics tools
Data Development & Transformation

Data Preparation & Processing

Extract, transform, and prepare analytical datasets using SQL, Python and scripting languages
Build and maintain reporting datasets, dataflows, and curated data assets incorporating key metrics and business data
Utilize enterprise data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric) as supporting data sources where required

Data Modeling & Documentation

Contribute to the design and optimization of data models that support reporting and analytics platforms
Develop and maintain documentation for datasets, data definitions, and analytical processes
Operational Excellence

Automation

Automate repetitive reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows using Python and scripting

DevOps

Utilize version control practices for analytics assets, reports, and code
Contribute to CI/CD processes for analytics solution deployment using Azure DevOps

Quality

Develop and maintain automated testing for reports, datasets, and analytics solutions
Support monitoring and validation of analytics pipelines and reporting processes
Apply development best practices including code quality, documentation, and peer review
Data Governance & Standards

Governance & Compliance

Apply data governance, compliance, and data quality standards when developing analytics solutions
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting outputs
Adhere to data privacy, security and compliance requirements (PII, PHI etc.)

Data Standards

Support adherence to established data policies, standards, and best practices
Other
Contribute to our culture of diversity, inclusion, belonging and equity (DIBE) by ensuring that all staff feel represented, valued, and heard across all aspects of their identity, including gender, age, religion, ethnicity, nationality, race, and sexuality.
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline
More than 3 years, up to and including 5 years - similar or related general experience in progressively more important positions

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analytical dataset development
Proficiency in Python and/or scripting languages for data analysis and automation
Experience designing and developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Salesforce Reporting, Salesforce CRM Analytics and Power BI
Experience building and optimizing semantic models and analytical datasets
Experience working with Fabric to build and manage data pipelines, dataflows, automated workflows, and analytics solutions.
Understanding of data modeling concepts and relational database design
Others may apply

Operational Excellence

Experience with DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks
Experience automating reporting, data preparation, and analytics workflows
Knowledge of Agile development practices including code quality, testing, documentation, and peer review
Experience developing and maintaining automated testing for analytics solutions and reports

Analytical Skills

Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, scalable analytics solutions
Strong exploratory data analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
Ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights from large and complex datasets
Experience with predictive modeling, statistical analysis, or data-driven segmentation techniques

Communication Skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to present complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience collaborating across business functions to support data-driven decision-making
Bilingualism (French/English) is highly preferred , with French being an asset due to the organization’s nationwide operations and the need for effective communication across various regions

What You Can Expect From Us

CCS provides impactful opportunities to transform the lives of Canadians affected by cancer. We are devoted to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse experiences and skills, encouraging all qualified candidates to join us. Our inspiring culture is rooted in our core values and commitment to meaningful change: COURAGEOUS UNITED CARING RIGOROUS

We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits, including paid parental leave, family sick time, and health insurance—and a fulfilling work environment where your efforts make a meaningful impact daily.

COME AS YOU ARE

At CCS, we celebrate individuality and the strength of diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace that empowers everyone. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those from equity-deserving groups such as BIPOC, 2SLGBTQI+ communities, individuals with disabilities, veterans, and others who contribute to the richness of our organization. Together, we unite Canadians to shape the future of cancer care.

How To Apply

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume, cover letter,
and salary expectations by August 27, 2026

We thank all candidates for their interest and advise that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Other Information

CCS is dedicated to employment equity and encourages applications from all qualified candidates . In accordance with the local provincial Accessibility Act
, accommodation will be provided as requested throughout the recruitment process . We want to make the interview process a great experience for you!

Please note that in keeping with the mandate of CCS to model and promote healthy lifestyles
, employees are not permitted to smoke in or about CCS premises or while carrying out CCS business.
